The account authenticated from an unauthorized host (10.0.6.31) and performed 14 privileged operations on Active Directory, including modifications to Domain Admins and Enterprise Admins groups. Golden Ticket indicators were observed in TGT metadata, suggesting potential Kerberos exploitation. Immediate actions included revocation of all sessions and API keys for the service account and blocking the source IP at the firewall. Post-incident telemetry shows no further malicious activity, but the initial UEBA system failed to flag the event due to low anomaly scoring despite clear privilege escalation.
